``` ## What this project does 1. **Measures every player per possession**, with small samples pulled toward their position's average (empirical Bayes), instead of per-36 numbers that overrate short stints. 2. **Groups players into style archetypes** (clustering on shot diet, creation, rebounding and defense), then checks the labels against hand labels and against how players change roles after trades. 3. **Links team archetype mix to winning:** net rating, playoff resilience and championships, and how the winning formula has drifted from era to era in each league. 4. **Asks whether pay follows value:** salary as a share of the cap, compared within contract types (rookie scale, minimum, max), with intervals. A player is called over- or under-paid only when the interval excludes zero. ::: {.caveat} Everything here is association, not causation. The WNBA sample is small (12-13 teams a season), so WNBA estimates carry wide intervals. Pages marked *in progress* will fill in as each step finishes. :::
